report.summary: C5 and its single-slot, 4096-context, batch-2047 profile were screened as one package. C5 screened against four prior quiet A+30 scopes. Median paired differences at 512 tokens (+3.181 s TTFT saved, +6.004 tok/s gained) and 2048 tokens (+7.400 s TTFT saved, +2.734 tok/s gained). Greedy output or reasoning differed. Paired first-token time saved at 512 / 2048 tokens was +0.06 s / +0.08 s in the separate fixed-flags stock screen. Greedy output or reasoning differed at 2048 tokens.
